evidence.quote: There are two broad classifications: high-level or low-level waste.
High-level radioactive waste primarily is uranium fuel that has been used in a nuclear power reactor
All U.S. nuclear power plants store spent nuclear fuel in "spent fuel pools."

objectives: Distinguish high-level waste from low-level waste
Describe how spent nuclear fuel is stored at reactor sites
Identify regulatory roles for storage and disposal of radioactive waste
analysis.unsupportedReason: The source covers classification storage and disposal of high-level and low-level radioactive waste and agency regulatory roles and does not teach a quantitative model matching any listed activity.
